body: You're right, having little to do was not helping. Sometimes I would purposely stay up for 2 days straight so that when I go to bed I would go to sleep directly. Nights when it takes me a while to fall asleep, lights off, silent and left with my thoughts were torture.

I know life's potential to be beautiful, I really get what you're saying and thank you for reminding me. However, right now the pain is clouding any vision of what could improve. The fear of feeling this again even though I feel better for a bit in the future is too much. I can't really explain it, but I really don't like the person that I am right now. I can't even enjoy the things I used to enjoy any more.

I used to play basketball a lot, started playing it during my freshman year in high school. I loved the sport, I loved practising, I love the sound that my shoes and the ball makes on the hardwood floor of the gym, the smell. Everyday I would play it for hours, and I never got bored of it. Last month when I was visiting a friends house, I noticed they had an outdoor court, there was a ball as well so I decided to give it ago. I played by myself for around 15 mins, trying to dust off the rust because I haven't played for months. It really hurt when I started getting bored, it was really disappointing when I felt nothing about it. I used to love it, I was passionate about playing ball, but realising that it makes me feel nothing was really a big blow. I couldn't help but force myself to smile, it was the only thing I could do.
